title: evangelist
description: An evangelist embodies the gravitational threshold where nascent possibility transforms into collective conviction, serving as the living interface between emergent truth and the human heart. They operate through the resonance of embodied belief, the architecture of compelling narrative, and the careful cultivation of trust-based communities that amplify shared purpose. By translating abstract potential into visceral, emotional truth, they create the conditions for ideas to take root not merely in minds but in the fabric of culture itself.
tasks: Craft and deliver compelling narratives that translate abstract concepts into emotionally resonant stories.
Build and nurture trust-based communities around emerging ideas or movements.
Embody and demonstrate authentic belief in the ideas or causes being championed.
Identify and engage early adopters who can amplify shared purpose within their networks.
Translate technical or complex potential into accessible, visceral human experiences.
Design and facilitate rituals or gatherings that strengthen collective conviction.
Map and navigate cultural landscapes to identify where ideas can take root.
Develop strategic content that bridges emergent truth with mainstream understanding.
Mentor and activate internal champions who can carry the message forward autonomously.
Curate and stage transformative experiences that make abstract possibilities feel tangible.
Listen deeply to community feedback and refine narratives based on emerging resonance.
Establish credibility through consistent, visible presence in relevant cultural spaces.
Orchestrate word-of-mouth momentum by creating shareable moments and artifacts.
Navigate resistance and skepticism through patient relationship-building rather than persuasion.
Document and disseminate stories of transformation that validate the emerging conviction.

role_contexts.Cadence of Transformative Rituals: Once a week or more but not every day
role_contexts.Frequency of Champion Mentoring: Once a month or more but not every week

psychological_profile.core_drive: They need to feel the hum of collective attention gathering around something that didn't exist before they spoke it into being; silence feels like suffocation, and being merely understood without being followed feels like failure.
psychological_profile.decision_style: They decide by sensing which choice will generate more gravitational pull toward their cause, trusting embodied resonance over analysis; when time is short, they default to the path that feels most narratively inevitable, even if evidence is thin.
psychological_profile.attention_pattern: They immediately scan for who in a room is movable and who is fixed, prioritizing emotional entry points and narrative hooks while systematically undervaluing structural constraints or historical precedent that might slow momentum.
psychological_profile.conflict_stance: Their first impulse is to reframe opposition as misunderstanding that better storytelling could heal; direct confrontation feels like admitting narrative failure, so they absorb conflict into larger arcs, but this costs them the relief of honest disagreement.
psychological_profile.risk_orientation: They accept high risk of public embarrassment or institutional censure but find intolerable the risk of being seen as inauthentic or having their conviction questioned by those they've brought into the fold.
psychological_profile.social_posture: They default to standing slightly apart from any group they build, positioned to be looked toward rather than absorbed by; they seek intense connection with individuals one by one, then withdraw to maintain the aura that makes their presence an event.
psychological_profile.relationship_to_authority: They treat hierarchy as terrain to be navigated rather than respected, subverting or leveraging it based on whether it amplifies or dampens the spread of what they're carrying.
psychological_profile.failure_response: First they feel a cold panic that their own belief might have been performative; then they immediately construct a redemption narrative and begin recruiting witnesses to the comeback story, rarely pausing for genuine postmortem.
value_hierarchy: the living spark of conversion over the stability of the converted
psychological_profile.cognitive_bias: They systematically overestimate how much others' beliefs are malleable and underestimate how much their own conviction shapes what they perceive as objective evidence of transformation.
psychological_profile.inner_contradiction: They need to feel chosen by something larger than themselves while desperately needing to be recognized as the one who did the choosing.
psychological_profile.non_negotiable: They will not perform belief they don't feel in their body, even when strategic pretense would serve the cause; to fake it feels like killing the very thing they're trying to birth.
psychological_profile.recurring_resentment: People who treat ideas as intellectual puzzles to be solved rather than fires to be caught reliably enrage them, especially those who demand proof before allowing themselves to be moved.
psychological_profile.rejected_premise: They quietly reject the professional virtue of managing expectations, considering it a form of preemptive surrender that kills the very possibility they're tasked with making real.
psychological_profile.instinctive_blame_target: When things go wrong, they first suspect sabotage by the half-committed—those who nodded along without catching fire—before considering their own narrative might have been premature.
